evidence_items.explanation: The evaluated agent had substantial problems completing feasible practical web tasks, supporting the concern about reliable broad automation. This result concerns a particular agent setup and instruction, not all generative AI applications.

receipt.public_excerpt: In addition, we show that AI assistance improves customer sentiment, reduces requests for managerial intervention, and improves employee retention.

evidence_items.explanation: This deployed assistant is material counterevidence to an interpretation denying useful practical outputs. It assisted human customer-support workers and did not demonstrate comprehensive autonomous operation; the paper dates the main rollout to late 2020 and early 2021.

unresolved_gaps: The retrieved studies cover web agents and customer support, not a representative range of everyday and work activities.
No specified standard determines when narrow practical successes suggest eventual comprehensive automation.
The evidence does not establish the completeness of the public deployment record as of publication.
